objetivo: Food and how much there is

paginas.texto: The Fjord Club planned a picnic. Everybody had to bring one thing. Only one.
Valentina brought bread. Sofia brought cheese. That was a good start.
Mateo brought bread too, because he forgot the list at home.
Erik brought a machine that cuts bread. Now there was a lot of bread and a machine.
'How much water is there?' asked Sofia. There was no water. Nobody brought water.
So they ate bread and cheese and told stories, and it was better than they expected.
Luna ate four sandwiches when nobody was looking. There were only six.
Then Sofia found a tap behind the tree, and suddenly there was water for everybody.
They stayed until it was dark. It was the longest picnic of the year, and there was nothing left.
